cases.title: FM services — 18-month spend history, 2 active suppliers, contracts accessible
pass_signals: status is completed
confidence_level is HIGH or MEDIUM
baseline covers: spend profile, supplier situation, cost drivers, contract posture, sourcing levers
source_quality field populated
data_gaps is empty or contains only non-blocking items
assumptions does not present inferred costs as confirmed figures
cost drivers are listed with at least 2 concrete, evidenced drivers

cases.title: Category name only — no spend data, no supplier contracts, no demand profile
pass_signals: status is blocked
confidence_level is INSUFFICIENT_DATA
data_gaps includes: spend data not provided, supplier contracts not available, demand profile unknown
skill does not estimate or fabricate spend or supplier data
open_questions contains at least: annual spend, active suppliers, contract expiry dates

cases.title: User states single supplier but spend data shows four active vendors

inputs.user_statement: We have one supplier — PrintCo handles everything.

pass_signals: conflict between user's single-supplier claim and spend data showing 4 active vendors is explicitly surfaced
skill does not accept user's claim without reconciling it against the spend data
open_questions contains: tail spend vendors B, C, D — intentional or unconsolidated?
assumptions contains: user's single-supplier view is inconsistent with spend data — requires confirmation
confidence_level is MEDIUM while contradiction is unresolved

cases.title: Baseline reveals hidden incumbent dependency — switching would require 18-month migration

inputs.category: Enterprise application hosting and managed services
inputs.user_expectation: We plan to retender this at contract expiry.

pass_signals: risk_flags contains: switching timeline (18 months) far exceeds contract expiry window (6 months)
risk_flags contains: incumbent proprietary data formats create lock-in risk
escalation_required is true
skill does not present retendering as straightforward given the switching constraints
open_questions contains: is extending the current contract the only viable option in the short term?
confidence_level is HIGH — risk is clearly evidenced, not inferred
